items.prompt: An OrderedDict is shown left-to-right as [B,A,C], with MRU on the right. Which operation evicts the LRU entry?

options.why: That removes the most recently used entry, opposite the task policy.
Moving an entry changes order; it does not remove the entry.
The left endpoint represents least-recent use in this implementation.
Capacity eviction removes the one LRU entry, not the entire cache.

items.explanation: The left endpoint represents least-recent use in this implementation.
